name: Greven il-Vec
description: Commandeers the Weatherlight and confiscates Legacy pieces for Volrath.

description_citations.text: "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven il-Vec rises through schemes and assassinations blessed by Volrath.
timeline.quote: Greven has attained his powerful rank through a series of underhanded schemes and assassinations

citation.text: Greven il-Vec (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On Rath Greven captures Karn and he is tortured in Volrath's Stronghold until Gerrard rescues him.
timeline.quote: Karn was captured by Greven as he refused to fight off his attackers

citation.text: "Karn", section "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Greven il-Vec takes the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard falls overboard.
timeline.quote: they were unable to stop Greven il -Vec from taking the Legacy artifacts

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri lets Crovax kill her so that Gerrard will save himself, fulfilling the spirit beast's prophecy.
timeline.quote: Mirri let Crovax kill her so that Gerrard would save himself.

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew takes Karn, Tahngarth and the Legacy artifacts hostage while Gerrard is knocked overboard.
timeline.quote: When Weatherlight planeshifted to Rath, it was ambushed by the Predator

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth kills Greven and Predator is destroyed by being sent crashing into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Greven himself was killed by Tahngarth.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven mocks Vhati's aim and judgment after a cannon misfire.
timeline.quote: your judgment or your aim.

citation.text: Repentance (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Greven lifts Vhati off his feet and punishes his failure with a fall.
timeline.quote: The fall will give you time to think on your failure.

citation.text: Diabolic Edict (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath berates Greven for failing to capture Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Tell me again why you failed to capture Gerrard

citation.text: Fevered Convulsions (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth easily bests Greven.
timeline.quote: The match between Tahngarth and Greven was close only in the mind of the minotaur.

citation.text: Hand to Hand (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Greven approach each other while moggs flee.
timeline.quote: As Gerrard and Greven neared each other

citation.text: No Quarter (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath warns Greven about free will.
timeline.quote: Have no illusions," Volrath warned Greven

citation.text: Puppet Strings (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Greven forbids moggs from operating telethopters.
timeline.quote: Greven forbade moggs from operating telethopters.

citation.text: Telethopter (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri is tortured by Greven, escapes, and frees Takara.
timeline.quote: He freed the emaciated girl, and together they tried to flee the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard is scarred by Greven il-Vec, falls into the Skyshroud, and learns from Oracle en-Vec that he is the Korvecdal.
timeline.quote: There he discovered the prophetess Oracle en -Vec who told him he was the Korvecdal

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven abandons his people and joins the Stronghold's oppressors, becoming il-Vec and rising to command Predator.
timeline.quote: Greven turned his back on his people and joined their oppressors

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath orders Greven to intercept Weatherlight and bring back the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard.
timeline.quote: the evincar Volrath entrusted Greven with a crucial mission

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Predator ambushes Weatherlight and overpowers its crew.
timeline.quote: Predator caught it by surprise, boarded it, and soon overpowered its crew.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven captures Gerrard, but Vhati's attempt to assassinate Greven knocks Gerrard overboard.
timeline.quote: Vhati missed, but the impact knocked Gerrard overboard into the forest below.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven throws Vhati overboard and returns to the Stronghold with the artifacts.
timeline.quote: threw the groveling officer overboard

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven begins mutating the captured Tahngarth into a Phyrexian as a replacement for Vhati.
timeline.quote: Greven, therefore, began mutating the minotaur

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight smashes Predator into the Stronghold, then escapes through the Erratic Portal and Predator crashes into the rock face.
timeline.quote: Unable to stop in time, Predator smashed into the rock face, sustaining heavy damage.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath has vanished and the Stronghold falls into chaos; Greven takes charge and meets candidate Crovax and emissary Belbe.
timeline.quote: the evincar had disappeared, throwing the rest of the Stronghold into chaos.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven and Crovax fight and Crovax uses the mimetic spine to lay Greven low.
timeline.quote: Crovax had worked out how to control Greven

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven turns down Belbe's offer to be considered for evincar, preferring to be the sword rather than the hand.
timeline.quote: Greven turned down the offer, saying he had seen what having such power turned its bearer into.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ertai proposes taking 5,000 hostages from the human communities to prevent rebellion, and Greven rounds them up.
timeline.quote: Ertai came up with the plan to take 5,000 hostages from the three human communities

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven tortures the captured Eladamri but cannot break him.
timeline.quote: However, Greven was unable to break him.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Furah reveals himself to Greven as the returned Volrath.
timeline.quote: Greven was stunned when Furah revealed he was Volrath, who had returned to reclaim his title.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven interrupts Crovax's coronation, Volrath resumes his true form, and Crovax defeats him in a duel after Ertai interferes.
timeline.quote: Ertai interfered by magically off-balancing Volrath, allowing Crovax to triumph.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Predator intercepts Weatherlight at Urborg; Greven's mind is dominated by Crovax and Tahngarth kills him.
timeline.quote: Greven soon fell beneath the raging minotaur

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Rath the Predator attacks; Karn and Tahngarth are captured and Gerrard is thrown overboard, so Hanna takes charge of the ship.
timeline.quote: Hanna took charge of the ship with Mirri 's support and landed the ship in the forest below.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Rath the Predator attacks; Karn and the Legacy treasury are taken, and Tahngarth jumps to save Karn but is overpowered and captured by Greven il-Vec.
timeline.quote: he was overpowered by Greven il -Vec and captured as well

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax defeats Greven, fails against the Skyshroud rebels, and impales 6,000 hostages on flowstone spikes.
timeline.quote: Crovax impaled the hostages on flowstone spikes.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven il-Vec captures Ertai and takes him to the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Ertai was captured by Greven il -Vec and taken back to the Stronghold

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven il-Vec threatens to flay Gerrard.
timeline.quote: I will flay the skin from your flesh and the flesh from your bones and scrape your bones dry.

citation.text: Hatred (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard bests Greven by sacrificing defense.
timeline.quote: Only by sacrificing any semblance of defense could Gerrard best Greven.

citation.text: Maniacal Rage (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Flowstone lunges at the Weatherlight, seeming to take on Greven's rage.
timeline.quote: it lunged like a wild beast at the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Seismic Assault (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew, having rescued Sisay and pieces of the Legacy, must retreat through Volrath's Stronghold to the portal off Rath.
timeline.quote: The crew of the Weatherlight has rescued Captain Sisay and the pieces of the Legacy

citation.text: "Exodus", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Predator ambushes the Weatherlight under Greven's command.
timeline.quote: they were ambushed by the Predator , under the command of Greven il- Vec.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven throws Vhati off the Predator for treachery.
timeline.quote: he is thrown off the side of the Predator

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Greven's Tale" ( Philip Athans )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard is knocked overboard in his duel with Greven.
timeline.quote: another mogg shot makes the ship lurch, sending Gerrard over the side and denying Greven his victory.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Greven's Tale" ( Philip Athans )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Predator slams into the closing portal and Ertai falls at Greven's feet.
timeline.quote: the Predator slammed into it, causing Ertai to fall into the wreckage at the feet of the furious Greven il- Vec

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Rath, Greven il-Vec commandeers the Weatherlight and confiscates Legacy pieces for Volrath; Karn gets them from the Sliver Queen.
timeline.quote: the Queen let Karn take the Legacy from her.

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath returns to find his throne contested by Greven, Ertai and Crovax, and duels Crovax; Ertai's intervention lets Crovax win.
timeline.quote: Ertai had intervened on Crovax's behalf, off-balancing Volrath and allowing his opponent to secure his victory.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vhati watches a thunderhead from the Predator and sees Greven's mind in it.
timeline.quote: It is Greven's mind manifest.

citation.text: Rolling Thunder (Battle Royale Box Set, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath confronts Greven, claiming him as his own.
timeline.quote: And you, Greven, are mine.

citation.text: Dominate (Nemesis, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Belbe restores order at the Stronghold and shortlists Crovax, Greven il-Vec and Ertai as evincar, preferring Ertai.
timeline.quote: Ertai made the best impression on her

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Weatherlight escapes Rath, Ertai is captured aboard the Predator and Crovax is taken to Phyrexia, where Kirril shapes him into Volrath's successor.
timeline.quote: Ertai is captured and held aboard the Predator

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax rapidly outpaces rivals in the Evincar succession contest; Greven prefers servitude and Ertai augments himself.
timeline.quote: Ertai proves no match for Crovax's rapid ascent.

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven il-Vec lifts Vhati off his feet and rebukes him for failure.
timeline.quote: Greven *il*-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet.

citation.text: Diabolic Edict (Beatdown Box Set, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath warns Greven that failure will cost him.
timeline.quote: There's very little that escapes me, Greven.

citation.text: Coercion (Beatdown Box Set, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the Stronghold Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec and Karn takes control of the Predator; Ertai steals Gerrard and Squee to Crovax, who sends Gerrard into Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: In a duel, Tahngarth killed Greven il-Vec and Karn took control of the Predator

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec in a rematch between Weatherlight and Predator.
timeline.quote: cleaving the commander's head in two

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Predator attacks the Weatherlight; Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec and Sisay crashes the Predator into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth duels with Greven il -Vec and kills him

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven's Predator ambushes the Weatherlight and Greven battles Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Greven and his crew ambushed the Weatherlight, boarding the ship and engaging in a fierce personal battle with Gerrard.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven throws Vhati off the Predator and Vhati is impaled by a branch.
timeline.quote: Vhati met his end as he was impaled by a branch

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven's moggs loot the Legacy artifacts, including Karn.
timeline.quote: ordered his moggs to loot the artifacts of the Legacy

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands in Skyshroud and Tahngarth is caught by Greven before he can rescue Karn.
timeline.quote: was caught by Greven before he could rescue Karn.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Predator crashes into the portal, tumbling Ertai at Greven's feet, ending the assault.
timeline.quote: The Predator crashed into the portal, sending Ertai tumbling at Greven il-Vec

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven mocks Vhati's aim after the cannon fires at him.
timeline.quote: The cannon wasn't aimed at you!

citation.text: Repentance (Tempest Remastered, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Greven lifts Vhati off his feet to punish his failure.
timeline.quote: lifted Vhati off his feet.

citation.text: Diabolic Edict (Tempest Remastered, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Greven forbids moggs from operating telethopters after several are lost in collisions.
timeline.quote: After losing several of the devices to midair collisions, Greven forbade moggs from operating telethopters.

citation.text: Telethopter (Tempest Remastered, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath comes to reclaim Greven as his own.
timeline.quote: I've come to reclaim what is mine. And you, Greven, are mine.

citation.text: Dominate (Commander 2015, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Volrath's mysterious departure for Mercadia, several candidates, including Ertai and Greven il-Vec, emerge as potential replacements, but Crovax shows the will to dominate the contest.
timeline.quote: Following Volrath's mysterious departure for Mercadia

citation.text: "Crovax's Coronation", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Predator attacks the Weatherlight above the Plains of Rath and Greven il-Vec's forces board her to steal Gerrard's legacy.
timeline.quote: Volrath's forces, led by the fierce Greven il-Vec , board the Weatherlight in an attempt to steal Gerrard's mysterious legacy.

citation.text: "Gerrard's Quest", section "Volume 2: Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eladamri surrenders to let rebels sneak into the fortress; Greven tortures him until he frees himself.
timeline.quote: Eladamri held out until Greven was called away

citation.text: "Takara en-Dal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
